title: Habría or Hubiera? Two Forms in the Result
goal: Use hubiera with the past participle as a common alternative to habría with the past participle in the result clause.
grammar: Hubiera in place of habría in the result

items: I can use hubiera and a past participle in place of habría in the result clause of a past counterfactual.
I can tell which clause may take hubiera in place of the conditional, and which may not.
I can use the new words for mistakes and corrections.
